title: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs quickstarts
author: Ava Chen
description:
Motivation: Provide curated RAG agent templates and concrete tool-calling examples to accelerate developer adoption of agents and RAG patterns. This PR adds opinionated quickstarts (Python/TS), agent templates for FAQ/summarization/search workflows, and updates the docs site quickstart pages. It also includes a small reference search connector example and instructions for wiring external tools (search, actions).

What changed: added 'examples/rag-agents/' with three template agents, 'docs/src/quickstarts/rag-agents.md' with step-by-step setup, updated Python and TypeScript SDK examples to show tool-calling patterns and structured output validation. CI: docs build and example smoke tests included.

Checklist:
- [x] Add RAG agent templates (faq-agent, summarizer-agent, assistant-with-tools)
- [x] Add tool-calling examples for search and calendar APIs (Python + TS)
- [x] Update docs quickstarts and sidebars
- [x] Add unit tests for example runners and lint fixes
- [x] Get reviews and CI green

Testing notes: Unit tests included for example-runner harness; smoke-tested quickstarts locally with mocked tool endpoints. Docs build passes and previews generated.

Related: ENG-3421 (RAG templates initiative), PM-512 (quickstart conversion). More context in the internal design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-3421/rag-agent-templates

Follow-ups: Add additional connectors (DB, vector stores) as separate PRs, and expand TypeScript examples with workflow orchestration samples.
